quiz.question_id: Keuntungan utama worker pool dibanding membuat satu goroutine per item?
quiz.question_en: The main advantage of a worker pool over creating one goroutine per item?
options_id: Mengontrol jumlah goroutine sehingga resource usage terbatas
options_en: Controls the number of goroutines so resource usage is bounded

quiz.question_id: Mengapa kita memanggil close(jobs) setelah mengirim semua jobs?
quiz.question_en: Why do we call close(jobs) after sending all jobs?
options_id: Agar workers tahu tidak ada job lagi dan bisa berhenti dari for-range loop
options_en: So workers know there are no more jobs and can exit the for-range loop
So the WaitGroup can be decremented

quiz.question_id: Mengapa results channel ditutup di goroutine terpisah setelah wg.Wait()?
quiz.question_en: Why is the results channel closed in a separate goroutine after wg.Wait()?
options_id: Agar main goroutine bisa mengumpulkan results sambil workers masih bekerja
Agar workers bisa mengirim lebih banyak results
Karena wg.Wait() harus dijalankan di goroutine terpisah
options_en: So the main goroutine can collect results while workers are still running
So workers can send more results
Because wg.Wait() must run in a separate goroutine
